name: AI Assistant
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: An assistant next to your mail. Ask about a message, write and rewrite, and look things up in your mail, calendar and contacts. It can also do small tasks for you. Works with an OpenAI-compatible service (OpenAI, Ollama, ...) or Anthropic. Nothing is sent until you ask.

defaultProvider.label: Default service
defaultProvider.description: Used when both services below are set up and the user hasn't picked one.

openaiBaseUrl.label: OpenAI-compatible API address
openaiBaseUrl.description: Address up to and including /v1, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://ollama:11434/v1. Leave empty to not offer it. A private address must be listed in PLUGIN_PROXY_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.

openaiKey.label: OpenAI-compatible API key
openaiKey.description: Stays on the server. For Ollama, which needs no key, enter any text (for example: ollama).

openaiModel.label: OpenAI-compatible model
openaiModel.description: For example gpt-4o-mini, or qwen2.5:7b on Ollama. Users may pick another one.

anthropicBaseUrl.label: Anthropic API address
anthropicBaseUrl.description: https://api.anthropic.com/v1, or a gateway that speaks the Messages API. Leave empty to not offer it.

anthropicModel.label: Anthropic model
anthropicModel.description: For example claude-haiku-4-5. Users may pick another one.

instructions.label: Instructions for the assistant
instructions.description: Standing instructions for everyone, added to every request: the organisation's tone, sign-offs, languages, things never to say. Users add their own in their settings.
instructions.placeholder:
For example:
Write in British English.
Sign off with "Kind regards".
Never promise delivery dates.

actions.label: Actions
actions.description: How far users may let the assistant act for them: archive, move and mark messages, add events, tasks and contacts, open replies in the composer. It never sends or deletes mail. Each user turns actions on in their settings; this is the most they can choose.

options.label: Ask first: users confirm each action
Automatic allowed: users may let it act without asking

allowUserKeys.label: Let users connect their own API key
allowUserKeys.description: Users then see a Connect button in the plugin's settings. Their key is stored encrypted on the server and replaces the keys above for them.

allowContext.label: More context
allowContext.description: Let the assistant read the open message's attachments and images, the whole conversation, the messages selected in the list, and messages, contacts and files the user mentions with @.

anthropicImages.label: Anthropic: images
anthropicImages.description: Whether the Anthropic model gets images (attachments, pictures in a message, image files). Automatic: yes, Anthropic's current models read images.

options.label: No, send the file name only

openaiImages.label: OpenAI-compatible: images
openaiImages.description: Whether the OpenAI-compatible model gets images. Automatic: yes for api.openai.com (apart from text-only models), no for other servers such as Ollama, whose models often can't read them.

options.label: No, send the file name only

allowMoreActions.label: More actions
allowMoreActions.description: Let the assistant answer invitations, change and delete events, tag messages, set the out-of-office reply, create filters and act on many messages at once. Each of these asks the user first.

batchLimit.label: Most messages per batch
batchLimit.description: How many messages one batch action (archive, move, mark, tag the results of a search) may change. 1 to 200.

allowSettingsChanges.label: Change settings
allowSettingsChanges.description: Let users allow the assistant to change their settings (appearance, reading, composing, list, notifications, calendar view). Never account, security, sharing, forwarding or plugin settings, and never one your policy locks. Each change asks first and can be undone. Off by default.

allowFiles.label: Files
allowFiles.description: Let the assistant find and read the user's files, attach them to drafts, save attachments to Files and create new files and folders. It never deletes or shares files.

allowChatTools.label: Chat tools
allowChatTools.description: Earlier chats, saved prompts, / commands, Edit and Answer again, notes the assistant remembers, and reading, inserting and saving templates. Off switches all of these off, notes and templates included.

prompts.label: Prompts for everyone
prompts.description: Saved prompts every user gets in the Actions menu and as / commands. One per line: Name: what to ask.

allowMemory.label: Remember notes
allowMemory.description: Let users have the assistant remember short notes about them (their manager's name, how to sign). Notes go to the AI service with every request.

allowEverywhere.label: Every view
allowEverywhere.description: Show the assistant in Calendar, Contacts, Files and Settings too, and offer Catch me up.
